comment: Institutional licensing responsibilities — A managed service cannot grant rights absent from the applicable terms. Apply the published WHO terms of use for ICD-11 content and software (https://icd.who.int/en/docs/ICD11-license.pdf), as revised from time to time, separately to content and software; verify the terms in force at publication. Translations, mappings and supplementary metadata require source-specific treatment. See C037; unpublished draft agreements are not substituted for operative terms.

Apply the published WHO terms of use for ICD-11 content and software (https://icd.who.int/en/docs/ICD11-license.pdf), as revised from time to time, separately to content and software; verify the terms in force at publication. public.suggestedRevision: Replace whole item: (4) Licensing obligations. Governance should identify the applicable terms, accountable parties, and recurring costs for each selected content source and software component. WHO's published ICD-11 content and software terms should be documented alongside those of other suppliers. Free access or a royalty-free software licence should not be described as permission to alter the international classification. Licence compliance should be monitored throughout deployment and exchange.
